title: The Material Science of Metal 3D Printing
summary: Real Engineering explains the materials science behind metal 3D printing, including crystal structure, laser sintering, and why printed parts develop fatigue cracks. It shows how process imperfections limit the strength of printed metal.
why: Commenters point to it whenever 3D-printed metal parts come up, as a clear explanation of why they have poor fatigue life and material defects.

quote.text: Great Real Engineering video with a lot of discussion of the issues with material properties, crystalline structure, and fatigue cracks
